meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把对话整理成需求规格并发布到项目跟踪
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们刚在聊天里敲定功能想法,想直接变成正式需求
copy.tagline_en: Turn your chat into a spec and post it to the project tracker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just discussed a feature in chat and want to turn it into a formal spec.

howto.what: 它会把当前对话内容整理成一份产品需求文档(PRD),包含问题、方案、用户故事、实现与测试决策等;写前会先查看项目代码,并与你确认测试边界,然后发布到项目问题追踪器,自动打上 ready-for-agent 标签。整个过程不向你提问。
howto.when: 当用户要求把当前对话转成规格说明并发布到项目问题追踪器时。若尚未配置问题追踪器和标签词汇,需先运行 /setup-matt-pocock-skills。

say.text: 把我们的讨论整理成 spec,发布到 issue tracker
say.note: 会生成 PRD 并自动打标签

say.text: 请根据刚才聊的内容写一份产品需求文档并提交
say.note: 它会综合对话,不再追问

say.text: 把当前对话变成规格说明,发到项目问题列表
say.note: 会确认测试边界后发布

howto.what_en: It converts your chat into a PRD (problem, solution, user stories, implementation/testing decisions) and publishes it to the issue tracker with the ready-for-agent label. No interview—just synthesizes your discussion. May confirm testing seams with you first.
howto.when_en: When you ask to turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker. If the tracker/triage vocabulary isn't set up, run /setup-matt-pocock-skills first.

say_en.text: Turn our discussion into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker
say_en.note: Generates a PRD and labels it automatically

say_en.text: Write a PRD from what we just discussed and submit it
say_en.note: Synthesizes the conversation, no further questions

say_en.text: Convert the current chat into a spec and post it to the project issues
